Designed event-driven microservices on AWS SQS to automate product and order sync with Zoho Books ERP, eliminating manual reconciliation
Built a secure digital wallet system handling refunds, cashback, and customer balance management end-to-end
Work cross-functionally with product, QA, and engineering to move features from spec to production reliably
Designed and shipped REST and GraphQL APIs with Node.js and NestJS across multiple client products
Drove a 40% reduction in API response times through query optimisation, caching strategies, and profiling
Owned architecture reviews and technical design discussions; maintained high code-quality standards through peer reviews
Mentored junior engineers and ran Agile ceremonies including sprint planning and retrospectives
Built backend services and REST APIs for SaaS products using Node.js and MongoDB
Introduced CI/CD automation that cut deployment errors by 50%
Collaborated directly with stakeholders on technical scoping and delivery planning
